translations.idiomatic: Deficiency-initial and excess-final limit: 121°75′.

sentences.zh: 求交初度：置所求積月，以朔差乘之，滿周天分去之，不盡，覆減周天分，滿交度母除之為度，不滿為餘，即得所求月交初度及餘；

translations.literal: To find initial crossing degree: set accumulated months sought, multiply by synodic difference; remove what fills circuit-of-heaven parts; if remainder remains, invert-subtract circuit-of-heaven parts; divide by crossing degree mother for degrees, remainder for parts—initial crossing degree and remainder for the month sought;
translations.idiomatic: Initial crossing degree: accumulated months × synodic difference; remove circuit of heaven; ÷ crossing mother = degrees and remainder;

sentences.zh: 以半周天加之，滿周天去之，餘為交中度及餘若以望差減之，即得其月望交初度及餘；

translations.literal: add half circuit of heaven; remove full circuit; remainder is mid-crossing degree and remainder. If subtract full-moon difference, obtain that month's full-moon initial crossing degree and remainder;
translations.idiomatic: add half circuit, remove full circuit for mid-crossing; subtract full-moon difference for full-moon initial crossing;

sentences.zh: 以朔差減之，即得次月交初度及餘；

translations.literal: subtract synodic difference for next month's initial crossing degree and remainder;
translations.idiomatic: subtract synodic difference for next month's initial crossing;

sentences.zh: 以交度母退除，即得餘分若以天正黃道日度加而命之，即各得交初，中所在宿度及分。

translations.literal: remove by crossing degree mother for remainder parts; add celestial-first yellow-path solar degree and assign—for each initial and mid crossing lodge degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: remove by crossing mother; add winter-solstice yellow-path degree and assign for crossing lodges.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚小餘及加時辰刻：以其朔，望月行遲疾定差疾加遲減經朔望小餘，若不足減者，退大餘一，加元法以減之；

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar greatest-eclipse minor remainder and addition-time double-hour ke: for new and full moon apply lunar fast-slow fixed difference—fast add, slow subtract—to mean new/full minor remainder; if insufficient to subtract, retreat major remainder one and add origin method to subtract;
translations.idiomatic: Greatest-eclipse minor remainder: apply lunar fast-slow fixed difference to mean syzygy minor remainder; retreat major remainder if needed;

sentences.zh: 若加之滿元法者，但積其數。

translations.literal: if addition fills origin method, only accumulate the number.
translations.idiomatic: if addition fills origin method, accumulate the number.

sentences.zh: 以一千三百三十七乘之，滿其度所直月行定分除之，為月行差數；

translations.literal: Multiply by 1,337; divide by that degree's lunar fixed parts for lunar motion difference number;
translations.idiomatic: ×1,337 ÷ lunar fixed parts at that degree = lunar motion difference;

sentences.zh: 乃以日躔盈定差盈加縮減之，餘為其朔，望食甚小餘。

translations.literal: then add or subtract solar excess-and-deficiency fixed difference—excess add, deficiency subtract; remainder is new/full greatest-eclipse minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: then ± solar excess-deficiency fixed difference for greatest-eclipse minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 凡加減滿若不足，進退其日，此朔望加時以究月行遲疾之數，若非有交會，直以經定小餘為定。

translations.literal: For all addition/subtraction if full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day—this new/full addition time exhausts lunar fast-slow numbers; if no conjunction, use mean fixed minor remainder directly as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Advance or retreat day if needed; without conjunction use mean fixed minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 置之，如前發斂加時術入之，即各得日，月食甚所在晨刻視食甚小餘，如半法以下者，覆減半法，餘為午前分；

translations.literal: Set it; enter by prior convergence addition-time procedure—for each solar/lunar greatest-eclipse morning ke. View greatest-eclipse minor remainder: if at or below half method, invert-subtract half method, remainder is before-noon parts;
translations.idiomatic: Assign by convergence procedure; ≤ half method → before-noon parts;

sentences.zh: 半法已上者，減去半法，餘為午後分。

translations.literal: if at or above half method, subtract half method, remainder is after-noon parts.
translations.idiomatic: ≥ half method → after-noon parts.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時日月度：以其朔，望加時小餘與經朔望小餘相減，餘以元法退收之，以加減其朔，望中日及約分，經朔望少，加；

translations.literal: To find new/full addition-time solar and lunar degrees: subtract mean new/full minor remainder from new/full addition-time minor remainder; remove by origin method; add or subtract new/full midday and reduced parts—if mean less, add; if mean more, subtract—for new/full addition-time midday sun;
translations.idiomatic: Addition-time degrees: difference of minor remainders ÷ origin; adjust midday sun (add if mean less, subtract if more);

sentences.zh: 經朔望多，減。

translations.literal: if mean more, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: if mean more, subtract.

sentences.zh: 為其朔，望加時中日乃以所入日升降分乘所入日約分，以一萬約之，所得，隨以損益其日下盈縮積，為盈縮定度；

translations.literal: Then multiply daily ascent-descent parts by that day's reduced parts, reduce by ten thousand; gain or lose the excess-deficiency accumulation below that day for fixed excess-deficiency degree;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply ascent-descent parts × reduced parts ÷10,000; adjust daily excess-deficiency accumulation;

sentences.zh: 以盈加縮減加時中日，為其朔，望加時定日；

translations.literal: excess add, deficiency subtract to addition-time midday sun for new/full addition-time fixed sun;
translations.idiomatic: apply to addition-time midday for fixed sun;

sentences.zh: 望則更加半周天，為加時定月；

translations.literal: for full moon also add half circuit of heaven for addition-time fixed moon;
translations.idiomatic: for full moon add half circuit for fixed moon;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即得所求朔，望加時日月所在宿度及分。

translations.literal: add to celestial-first winter-solstice yellow-path solar degree and assign—for sought new/full addition-time solar and lunar lodge degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: add to winter-solstice yellow-path degree and assign for syzygy addition-time lodges.

sentences.zh: 求朔望日月加時去交度分：置朔望日月加時定度與交初，交中度相減，餘為去交度分就近者相減之，其度以百通之為分。

translations.literal: To find new/full addition-time distance-from-crossing degree and parts: subtract initial or mid crossing from new/full addition-time fixed degree; remainder is distance from crossing; subtract the nearer; express degrees with hundred for parts.
translations.idiomatic: Distance from crossing: addition-time fixed degree − initial or mid crossing; subtract nearer value; degrees ×100 for parts.

sentences.zh: 加時度多為後，少為前，即得其朔望去交前，後分交初後，交中前，為月行外道陽曆；

translations.literal: If addition-time degree is greater it is after, if less before—distance before or after crossing. After initial crossing and before mid crossing is moon on outer path yang calendar;
translations.idiomatic: Greater = after, less = before crossing. After initial, before mid = outer path yang calendar;

sentences.zh: 交中後，交初前，為月行內道陰曆。

translations.literal: after mid crossing and before initial crossing is moon on inner path yin calendar.
translations.idiomatic: after mid, before initial = inner path yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 求日食四正食差定數：置其朔加時定日，如半周天以下者為在盈。

translations.literal: To find four-quadrant solar eclipse difference fixed numbers: set new-moon addition-time fixed sun; if at or below half circuit it is in excess.
translations.idiomatic: Four-quadrant solar eclipse difference: if fixed sun ≤ half circuit = excess.

sentences.zh: 以上者去之，餘為在縮視之，如在初限以下者為在初以上。

translations.literal: if above, remove; remainder is in deficiency. Observe: if at or below initial limit it is in initial; if above
translations.idiomatic: if above, remove; = deficiency; ≤ initial limit = initial; if above

sentences.zh: 者，覆減二至限，餘為在末，置初，末限度及分，盈初限，縮末限者倍之。

translations.literal: invert-subtract two-solstice limit; remainder is in final; set initial and final limit degree and parts; for excess-initial and deficiency-final limits, double them.
translations.idiomatic: invert two-solstice limit for final; double limits for excess-initial/deficiency-final.

sentences.zh: 置於上位，列二百四十三度半於下，以上減下，餘以下乘上，以一百六乘之，滿三千九十三除之，為東西食差泛數。

translations.literal: Set above, array 243°½ below, upper minus lower, lower times upper, multiply by 106, divide by 3,093—for east-west eclipse general difference number.
translations.idiomatic: Array 243°½ below, upper − lower, lower × upper ×106 ÷3,093 = east-west eclipse general difference.

sentences.zh: 用減五百八，餘為南北食差泛數。

translations.literal: Subtract from 508; remainder is north-south eclipse general difference number.
translations.idiomatic: 508 − result = north-south eclipse general difference.

sentences.zh: 其求南北食差定數者，乃視午前，後分，如四分法之一以下者覆減之，餘以乘泛數。

translations.literal: To find north-south eclipse fixed difference: view before- or after-noon parts; if at or below one-fourth method invert-subtract, remainder times general difference.
translations.idiomatic: North-south fixed difference: before/after-noon parts ≤¼ method → invert, × general difference.

sentences.zh: 若以上者即去之，餘以乘泛數，皆滿九千七百五十除之，為南北食差定數盈初縮末限者，食甚在卯酉以南，內減外加；

translations.literal: if above, remove; remainder times general difference; all divide by 9,750 for north-south eclipse fixed difference. For excess-initial/deficiency-final, if greatest eclipse south of mao-you, subtract inside add outside;
translations.idiomatic: if above, remove then ×; ÷9,750; excess-initial/deficiency-final: south of mao-you inner subtract outer add;

sentences.zh: 食甚在卯酉以北，內加外減。

translations.literal: if greatest eclipse north of mao-you, inner add outer subtract.
translations.idiomatic: north of mao-you: inner add outer subtract.

sentences.zh: 縮初盈末限者，食甚在卯酉以南，內加外減；

translations.literal: For deficiency-initial/excess-final, if greatest eclipse south of mao-you, inner add outer subtract;
translations.idiomatic: deficiency-initial/excess-final south of mao-you: inner add outer subtract;

sentences.zh: 食甚在卯酉以北，內減外加。

translations.literal: if north of mao-you, inner subtract outer add.
translations.idiomatic: north of mao-you: inner subtract outer add.

sentences.zh: 其求東西食差定數者，乃視午前，後分，如四分法之一以下者以乘泛數；

translations.literal: To find east-west eclipse fixed difference: view before/after-noon parts; if ≤ one-fourth method, multiply general difference;
translations.idiomatic: East-west fixed: ≤¼ method × general difference;

sentences.zh: 以上者，覆減半法，餘乘泛數，皆滿九千七百五十除之前，為東西食差定數。

translations.literal: if above, invert-subtract half method, remainder times general difference; all divide by 9,750—for east-west eclipse fixed difference before.
translations.idiomatic: if above, invert half method, × general difference, ÷9,750.

sentences.zh: 盈初縮末限者，食甚在子午以東，內減外加；

translations.literal: For excess-initial/deficiency-final, if greatest eclipse east of zi-wu, inner subtract outer add;
translations.idiomatic: excess-initial/deficiency-final east of zi-wu: inner subtract outer add;

sentences.zh: 食甚在子午以西，內加外減。

translations.literal: if greatest eclipse west of zi-wu, inner add outer subtract.
translations.idiomatic: west of zi-wu: inner add outer subtract.

sentences.zh: 外減；

translations.literal: outer subtract;
translations.idiomatic: outer subtract;

sentences.zh: 食甚在子午以西，內減外加。

translations.literal: if greatest eclipse west of zi-wu, inner subtract outer add.
translations.idiomatic: west of zi-wu: inner subtract outer add.

sentences.zh: 即得其朔四正食差加減定數。

translations.literal: Thus obtain the four-quadrant eclipse difference fixed numbers for new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the four-quadrant eclipse adjustment fixed numbers.

sentences.zh: 求日月食去交定分：視其朔四正食差，加減定數，同名相從，異名相消，餘為食差加減總數；

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse distance-from-crossing fixed parts: view four-quadrant eclipse differences; same name combine, different name cancel; remainder is total eclipse adjustment;
translations.idiomatic: Eclipse fixed parts: combine quadrant adjustments (same add, different subtract);

sentences.zh: 以加減去交分，餘為日食去交定分其去交定分不足減，乃覆減食差總數，若陽曆覆減入陰曆，為入食限；

translations.literal: add or subtract to distance-from-crossing parts; remainder is solar eclipse distance-from-crossing fixed parts. If fixed parts insufficient, invert-subtract total; if yang calendar inverts to yin, enters eclipse limit;
translations.idiomatic: adjust distance from crossing; if yang inverts to yin = enters eclipse limit;

sentences.zh: 若陰曆覆減入陽曆，為不入食限凡加之滿食限以上者，亦不入食限。

translations.literal: if yin inverts to yang, does not enter eclipse limit. Whatever addition fills eclipse limit or above also does not enter.
translations.idiomatic: yin to yang = no eclipse; filling limit also excludes eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其望食者，以其望去交分便為其望月食去交定分。

translations.literal: For full-moon eclipse, the full-moon distance-from-crossing parts are the full-moon eclipse fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Full-moon eclipse uses full-moon distance-from-crossing directly.

sentences.zh: 求日月食分：日食者，視去交定分，如食限三之一以下者倍之，類同陽曆食分。

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse parts: for solar eclipse, if distance-from-crossing fixed parts are at or below one-third of eclipse limit, double—same as yang-calendar eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: Solar eclipse parts: ≤⅓ limit doubled = yang eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 以上者，覆減食限，餘為陰曆食分皆進一位，滿九百七十六除為大分，不滿，退除為小分，命十為限，即日食之大，小分。

translations.literal: if above, invert-subtract eclipse limit; remainder is yin-calendar eclipse parts—all advance one place, divide by 976 for major parts, else minor parts, command ten as limit—for solar eclipse major and minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: above: invert limit for yin parts; advance one place ÷976 for major/minor solar eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 月食者，視去交定分，如食限三之一以下者，食既；

translations.literal: For lunar eclipse, if distance-from-crossing fixed parts ≤ one-third limit, eclipse total;
translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse: ≤⅓ limit = total eclipse;

sentences.zh: 以上者，覆減食限餘進一位，滿八百九十二除之為大分，不滿，退除為小分，命十為限，即月食之大，小分其食不滿大分者，雖交而數淺，或不見食也。

translations.literal: if above, invert-subtract limit remainder, advance one place, divide by 892 for major parts, else minor parts, command ten as limit—for lunar eclipse major and minor parts. If parts do not fill major part, though crossing, numbers shallow—eclipse may not be seen.
translations.idiomatic: else invert, ÷892; shallow numbers may hide eclipse despite crossing.

sentences.zh: 求日食泛用刻分：置陰、陽曆食分於上，列一千九百五十二於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，滿二百七十一除之，為日食泛用刻、分。

translations.literal: To find solar eclipse general usable ke parts: set yin/yang eclipse parts above, array 1,952 below, upper minus lower, remainder times upper, divide by 271—for solar eclipse general usable ke and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Solar general usable ke: yin/yang parts vs 1,952, upper − lower, × upper ÷271.

sentences.zh: 求月食泛用刻分：置去交定分，自相乘，交初以四百五十九除，交中以五百四十除之，所得，交初以減三千九百，交中以減三千三百一十五，餘為月食泛用刻、分。

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse general usable ke parts: set distance-from-crossing fixed parts, self-square; initial crossing divide by 459, mid-crossing by 540; initial crossing subtract from 3,900, mid-crossing from 3,315—for lunar eclipse general usable ke and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar general usable ke: distance²; initial ÷459, mid ÷540; subtract from 3,900 or 3,315.

sentences.zh: 求日月食定用刻分：置日月食泛用刻、分，以一千三百三十七乘之，以所直度下月行定分除之，所得為日月食定用刻、分。

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse fixed usable ke parts: set general usable ke parts, multiply by 1,337, divide by lunar fixed parts at that degree—for fixed usable ke and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed usable ke: general ×1,337 ÷ lunar fixed parts at degree.

sentences.zh: 求日月食虧初复滿時刻：以定用刻分減食甚小餘，為虧初小餘；

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse first loss and full return times: subtract fixed usable ke parts from greatest-eclipse minor remainder for first-loss minor remainder;
translations.idiomatic: First loss: greatest-eclipse minor remainder − fixed usable ke;

sentences.zh: 加食甚，為复滿小餘；

translations.literal: add to greatest eclipse for full-return minor remainder;
translations.idiomatic: greatest eclipse + fixed usable = full return;

sentences.zh: 各滿辰法為辰數，不盡，滿刻法除之為刻數，不滿為分。

translations.literal: each fills double-hour method for double-hour count, remainder by clepsydra method for ke, else parts.
translations.idiomatic: ÷ double-hour method for hours, clepsydra for ke and parts.

sentences.zh: 命辰數從子正，算外，即得虧初、复末辰、刻及分。

translations.literal: Count double-hours from zi midnight outward—for first loss and last return double-hours, ke, and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count from zi midnight for first loss and last return times.

sentences.zh: 若以半辰數加之，即命從時初也。

translations.literal: If add half double-hour count, count from double-hour initial.
translations.idiomatic: Add half double-hour to count from hour initial.

sentences.zh: 求日月食初虧复滿方位：其日食在陽曆者，初食西南，甚於正南，复於東南；

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar eclipse first loss and full return direction: for solar eclipse in yang calendar, first contact southwest, greatest due south, return southeast;
translations.idiomatic: Solar yang path: first SW, greatest south, return SE;

sentences.zh: 日在陰曆者，初食西北，甚於正北，复於東北其食過八分者，皆初食正西，复於正東其月食者，月在陰曆，初食東南，甚於正南，复於西南；

translations.literal: in yin calendar, first northwest, greatest due north, return northeast. If eclipse exceeds eight parts, all first due west, return due east. For lunar eclipse, moon in yin calendar first southeast, greatest south, return southwest;
translations.idiomatic: yin path: NW, N, NE; >8 parts: W/E. Lunar yin: SE, S, SW;

sentences.zh: 月在陽曆，初食東北，甚於正北，复於西北。

translations.literal: moon in yang calendar, first northeast, greatest north, return northwest.
translations.idiomatic: yang moon: NE, N, NW.

sentences.zh: 其食八分已上者，皆初食正東，复於正西。

translations.literal: If eclipse eight parts or more, all first due east, return due west.
translations.idiomatic: ≥8 parts: first east, return west.

sentences.zh: 此皆審其食甚所向，據午正而論之，其食餘方察其斜正，則初虧，复滿乃可知矣。

translations.literal: All observe the direction of greatest eclipse relative to noon due south; inspect obliquity of remainder direction—then first loss and full return can be known.
translations.idiomatic: Orient by greatest-eclipse direction from noon south; obliquity reveals first loss and return.

sentences.zh: 求月食更點定法：倍其望晨分，五而一，為更法；

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse watch-point fixed method: double full-moon dawn parts, one-fifth for watch method;
translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse watches: double full-moon dawn parts ÷5 = watch method;

sentences.zh: 又五而一，為點法若依司辰星注曆，同內中更點，則倍晨分，減去待旦十刻之分，餘，五而一，為更法；

translations.literal: again one-fifth for point method. If per Directorate star annotated calendar inner watches, double dawn parts, subtract awaiting-dawn ten ke parts, remainder one-fifth for watch method;
translations.idiomatic: ÷5 again for points; Directorate version subtract awaiting-dawn 10 ke first;

sentences.zh: 又五而一，為點法。

translations.literal: again one-fifth for point method.
translations.idiomatic: ÷5 again for point method.

sentences.zh: 求月食入更點：各置初虧，食甚，复滿小餘，如在晨分以下者加晨分，如在昏分以上者減去昏分，餘以更法除之為更數，不滿，以點法除之為點數。

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse entered watch and point: set first loss, greatest eclipse, and full return minor remainders; if at or below dawn parts add dawn parts; if at or above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; divide remainder by watch method for watch count, remainder by point method for point count.
translations.idiomatic: Eclipse watch entry: adjust by dawn/dusk; ÷ watch and point methods.

sentences.zh: 其更數命初更，算外，即各得所入更，點。

translations.literal: Count watches from first watch outward—for each entered watch and point.
translations.idiomatic: Count from first watch for entered watch and point.

sentences.zh: 求月食既內外刻分：置月食去交分，覆減食限三之一，不及減者為食不既。

translations.literal: To find lunar eclipse totality inner and outer ke parts: set lunar eclipse distance-from-crossing parts, invert-subtract one-third of eclipse limit; if cannot subtract, eclipse is not total.
translations.idiomatic: Totality inner/outer: distance from crossing invert − ⅓ limit; cannot subtract = not total.

sentences.zh: 餘列於上位；

translations.literal: Set remainder above;
translations.idiomatic: Set remainder above;

sentences.zh: 乃列三之二於下，以上減下，餘下下乘上，以一百七十除之，所得，以定用刻分乘之，滿泛用刻分除之，為月食既內刻分；

translations.literal: array two-thirds below, upper minus lower, lower times lower times upper, divide by 170; multiply by fixed usable ke parts, divide by general usable ke parts—for lunar eclipse totality inner ke parts;
translations.idiomatic: array ⅔ below, compute, × fixed usable ÷ general = totality inner ke;

sentences.zh: 用減定用刻分，餘為既外刻，分。

translations.literal: subtract from fixed usable ke parts; remainder is outer ke and parts.
translations.idiomatic: fixed usable − inner = outer ke and parts.

sentences.zh: 求日月帶食出入所見分數：視食甚小餘在日出分以下者，為月見食甚，日不見食甚；

translations.literal: To find solar and lunar grazing-eclipse entry-exit visible parts: if greatest-eclipse minor remainder is below sunrise parts, moon sees greatest eclipse, sun does not;
translations.idiomatic: Grazing eclipse visibility: if greatest eclipse < sunrise parts, moon sees, sun does not;

sentences.zh: 以日出分減复滿小餘，若食甚小餘在日出分已上者，為日見食甚，月不見食甚；

translations.literal: subtract full-return minor remainder from sunrise parts; if greatest eclipse above sunrise parts, sun sees greatest, moon does not;
translations.idiomatic: if above sunrise, sun sees greatest; subtract first loss from sunrise for grazing difference;

sentences.zh: 以初虧小餘減日出分，各為帶食差；

translations.literal: subtract first-loss minor remainder from sunrise parts—each is grazing difference;
translations.idiomatic: each yields grazing difference;

sentences.zh: 若月食既者，以既內刻分減帶食差，餘乘所食分，既外刻分而一，不及減者，即帶食既出入也。

translations.literal: if lunar eclipse total, subtract totality inner ke parts from grazing difference, remainder times eclipse parts, outer ke parts for one—if cannot subtract, grazing totality entry-exit.
translations.idiomatic: total lunar eclipse: adjust grazing by totality inner/outer ke.

sentences.zh: 以乘所食之分，滿定用刻分而一，即各為日帶食出，月帶食入所見之分。

translations.literal: multiply by eclipse parts, divide by fixed usable ke parts for one—each is solar grazing exit and lunar grazing entry visible parts.
translations.idiomatic: × eclipse parts ÷ fixed usable = visible grazing parts.

sentences.zh: 凡虧初小餘多如日出分為在晝，复滿小餘多如日出分為在夜，不帶食出入也。

translations.literal: If first-loss minor remainder exceeds sunrise parts it is daytime; if full-return exceeds sunrise parts it is night—no grazing entry-exit.
translations.idiomatic: First loss > sunrise = daytime; full return > sunrise = night—no grazing.

sentences.zh: 若食甚小餘在日入分以下者，為日見食甚，月不見食甚；

translations.literal: If greatest-eclipse minor remainder is below sunset parts, sun sees greatest, moon does not;
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse < sunset parts, sun sees, moon does not;

sentences.zh: 以日入分減复滿小餘，若食甚小餘在日入分已上者，為月見食甚，日不見食甚；

translations.literal: subtract full-return from sunset parts; if greatest eclipse above sunset parts, moon sees greatest, sun does not;
translations.idiomatic: if above sunset, moon sees; subtract first loss from sunset for grazing difference;

sentences.zh: 以初虧小餘減日入分，各為帶食差；

translations.literal: subtract first-loss from sunset parts—each is grazing difference;
translations.idiomatic: each yields grazing difference;

sentences.zh: 若月食既者，以既內刻分減帶食差，餘乘所差分，既外刻分而一，不及減者，即帶食既出入也。

translations.literal: if lunar eclipse total, subtract totality inner ke from grazing difference, remainder times difference parts, outer ke for one—if cannot subtract, grazing totality entry-exit.
translations.idiomatic: total lunar: adjust grazing by totality inner/outer ke.

sentences.zh: 以乘所食之分，滿定用刻分而一，即各為日帶食入，月帶食出所見之分。

translations.literal: multiply by eclipse parts, divide by fixed usable ke for one—each is solar grazing entry and lunar grazing exit visible parts.
translations.idiomatic: × eclipse parts ÷ fixed usable = grazing entry/exit parts.

sentences.zh: 凡虧初小餘多如日入分為在夜，复滿小餘少如日入分為在晝，並不帶食出入也。

translations.literal: If first-loss minor remainder exceeds sunset parts it is night; if full-return is less than sunset parts it is day—no grazing entry-exit.
translations.idiomatic: First loss > sunset = night; full return < sunset = day—no grazing.

sentences.zh: 步五星術

translations.literal: Method for stepping the five planets.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for the Five Planets.

sentences.zh: 木星終率：一千五百五十五萬六千五百四。

translations.literal: Jupiter terminal rate: 15,556,504.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter terminal rate: 15,556,504.

sentences.zh: 終曰：三百九十八日餘三萬四千五百四，約分八千八百四十七。

translations.literal: Terminal day: 398 days remainder 34,504, reduced parts 8,847.
translations.idiomatic: Terminal period: 398 days remainder 34,504, reduced parts 8,847.

sentences.zh: 曆差：六萬一千七百五十。

translations.literal: Sequence difference: 61,750.
translations.idiomatic: Sequence difference: 61,750.

sentences.zh: 見伏常度：一十四度。

translations.literal: Appearance and hiding constant degree: 14 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Appearance and hiding constant arc: 14°.

sentences.zh: 火星終率：三千四十一萬七千五百三十六。

translations.literal: Mars terminal rate: 30,417,536.
translations.idiomatic: Mars terminal rate: 30,417,536.

sentences.zh: 終曰：七百七十九日餘三萬六千五百三十六，約分九千三百六十八。

translations.literal: Terminal day: 779 days remainder 36,536, reduced parts 9,368.
translations.idiomatic: Mars terminal period: 779 days remainder 36,536, reduced parts 9,368.

sentences.zh: 曆差：六萬一千二百四十。

translations.literal: Sequence difference: 61,240.
translations.idiomatic: Sequence difference: 61,240.

sentences.zh: 見伏常度：一十八度。

translations.literal: Appearance and hiding constant degree: 18 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Appearance constant arc: 18°.

sentences.zh: 土星終率：一千四百七十四萬五千四百四十六。

translations.literal: Saturn terminal rate: 14,745,446.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn terminal rate: 14,745,446.

sentences.zh: 終曰：三百七十八餘三千四百四十六，約分八百八十三。

translations.literal: Terminal day: 378 remainder 3,446, reduced parts 883.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn terminal period: 378 days remainder 3,446, reduced parts 883.

sentences.zh: 曆差：六萬一千三百五十。

translations.literal: Sequence difference: 61,350.
translations.idiomatic: Sequence difference: 61,350.

sentences.zh: 見伏常度：一十八度半。

translations.literal: Appearance and hiding constant degree: 18 degrees and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Appearance constant arc: 18°30′.

sentences.zh: 金星終率：二千二百七十七萬二千一百九十六。

translations.literal: Venus terminal rate: 22,772,196.
translations.idiomatic: Venus terminal rate: 22,772,196.

sentences.zh: 終曰：五百八十三日餘三萬五千一百九十六，約分九千二十四。

translations.literal: Terminal day: 583 days remainder 35,196, reduced parts 9,024.
translations.idiomatic: Venus terminal period: 583 days remainder 35,196, reduced parts 9,024.

sentences.zh: 見伏常度：一十一度少。

translations.literal: Appearance and hiding constant degree: 11 degrees and a fraction less.
translations.idiomatic: Appearance constant arc: 11° slightly less.

sentences.zh: 水星終率：四百五十一萬九千一百八十四改九千一百九十四。

translations.literal: Mercury terminal rate: 4,519,184—revised 9,194.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury terminal rate: 4,519,184 (revised 9,194).

sentences.zh: 終曰：一百一十五日餘三萬四千一百八十四，約分八千七百六十五。

translations.literal: Terminal day: 115 days remainder 34,184, reduced parts 8,765.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury terminal period: 115 days remainder 34,184, reduced parts 8,765.

sentences.zh: 見伏常度：一十八度。

translations.literal: Appearance and hiding constant degree: 18 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Appearance constant arc: 18°.

sentences.zh: 求五星天正冬至後諸段中積中星：置氣積分，各以其星終率去之，不盡，覆減終率，餘滿元法為日，不滿，退除為分，即天正冬至後其星平合中積。

translations.literal: To find each planet's accumulated center and star after celestial-first winter solstice: set qi accumulated parts; remove what fills each star's terminal rate; if remainder remains, invert-subtract terminal rate; remainder filling origin method is days, else retreat for parts—the mean conjunction accumulated center after winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Post–winter-solstice mean conjunction: qi parts mod terminal rate; ÷ origin = days.

sentences.zh: 重列之為中星，因命為前一段之初，以諸段變日，變度累加減之，即為諸段中星，變日加減中積，變度加減中星。

translations.literal: Array it again as center star; assign as start of prior segment; accumulate segment change days and change degrees by addition and subtraction—for each segment center star; change days adjust accumulated center, change degrees adjust center star.
translations.idiomatic: Re-array as center star; accumulate segment day/degree changes.

sentences.zh: 求木火土三星入曆：以其星曆差乘積年，滿周天分去之，不盡，以度母除之為度，不滿，退除為分，命曰差度；

translations.literal: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn entry into sequence: multiply accumulated years by that star's sequence difference; remove full circuit-of-heaven parts; divide remainder by degree mother for degrees, remainder for parts—name difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Wood/Mars/Saturn sequence entry: years × sequence difference mod circuit; ÷ degree mother.

sentences.zh: 以減其星平合中星，即為平合入曆度分；

translations.literal: subtract from that star's mean-conjunction center star—for mean-conjunction sequence entry degree and parts;
translations.idiomatic: subtract from mean-conjunction center star for sequence entry;

sentences.zh: 以其星其段曆度加之，滿周天度分即去之，各得其星其段入曆度分金，水附日而行，更不求曆差。

translations.literal: add that star's segment sequence degree; remove full circuit—for each star's segment sequence entry. Venus and Mercury follow the sun—do not seek sequence difference.
translations.idiomatic: add segment sequence degree; Venus/Mercury follow the sun.

sentences.zh: 其木，火，土三星前變為晨，後變為夕。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, prior change is morning, posterior change is evening.
translations.idiomatic: Wood/Mars/Saturn: prior change = morning, posterior = evening.

sentences.zh: 金，水二星前變為夕，後變為晨。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, prior change is evening, posterior is morning.
translations.idiomatic: Venus/Mercury: prior = evening, posterior = morning.

sentences.zh: 求木火土三星諸段盈縮定差：木，土二星，置其星其段入曆度分，如半周天以下者為在盈以上者，減去半周天，餘為在縮置。

translations.literal: To find wood, fire, and earth segments' excess-deficiency fixed difference: set that star's segment sequence entry; if at or below half circuit it is in excess; if above subtract half circuit, remainder in deficiency. Set
translations.idiomatic: Segment excess-deficiency: ≤ half circuit = excess; else deficiency.

sentences.zh: 盈縮度分，如在一象以下者為在初限。

translations.literal: excess-deficiency degree parts; if at or below one quadrant it is in initial limit.
translations.idiomatic: ≤ one quadrant = initial limit.

sentences.zh: 以上者，覆減半周天，餘為在末限。

translations.literal: If above, invert-subtract half circuit; remainder is in final limit.
translations.idiomatic: Above: invert half circuit for final limit.

sentences.zh: 置初，末限度及分於上，列半周天於下，以上減下，以下乘上，木進一位，土九因之。

translations.literal: Set initial/final limit degree above, array half circuit below, upper minus lower, lower times upper; wood advance one place, earth multiply by nine.
translations.idiomatic: Initial/final vs half circuit; wood ×10, earth ×9.

sentences.zh: 皆滿百為分，分滿百為度，命曰盈縮定差。

translations.literal: All fill 100 for parts, parts fill 100 for degrees—name excess-deficiency fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: ÷100 twice = excess-deficiency fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 其火星，置盈縮度分，如在初限以下者為在初。

translations.literal: For Mars, set excess-deficiency degree parts; if at or below initial limit it is in initial.
translations.idiomatic: Mars: ≤ initial limit = initial.

sentences.zh: 以上者，覆減半周天，餘為在末。

translations.literal: If above, invert-subtract half circuit; remainder is in final.
translations.idiomatic: Above: invert half circuit for final.

sentences.zh: 以四十五度六十五分半為盈初，縮末限度，以一百三十六度九十六分半為縮初，盈末限度分。

translations.literal: Use 45°65′½ as excess-initial and deficiency-final limit; use 136°96′½ as deficiency-initial and excess-final limit parts.
translations.idiomatic: Mars limits: 45°65′½ excess-initial/deficiency-final; 136°96′½ deficiency-initial/excess-final.

sentences.zh: 置初，末限度於上，盈初，縮末三因之。

translations.literal: Set initial/final limit above; excess-initial/deficiency-final triple it.
translations.idiomatic: Triple initial/final for excess-initial/deficiency-final.

sentences.zh: 列二百七十三度九十三分於下，以上減下，餘以下乘上，以一十二乘之，滿百為度，不滿，百約為分，命曰盈縮定差若。

translations.literal: Array 273°93′ below, upper minus lower, remainder lower times upper, multiply by 12; fill 100 for degrees else reduce by 100 for parts—name excess-deficiency fixed difference. If
translations.idiomatic: 273°93′ procedure ×12 = Mars fixed difference. If

sentences.zh: 用立成法，以其度下損益率乘度下約分，滿百者，以損益其度下盈縮差度為盈縮定差，若在留退段者，即在盈縮泛差。

translations.literal: using ready reckoner, multiply reduced parts below degree by gain-loss rate below; if fills 100, gain or lose excess-deficiency difference below for fixed difference; if in station-retreat segment, use excess-deficiency general difference.
translations.idiomatic: Ready reckoner: rate × parts; station-retreat uses general difference.

sentences.zh: 求木火土三星留退差：置後退，後留盈縮泛差，各列其星盈縮極度於下，木極度，八度三十三分；

translations.literal: To find wood, fire, earth station-retreat difference: set posterior retreat and posterior station general differences; array each star's excess-deficiency extreme below—wood extreme 8°33′;
translations.idiomatic: Station-retreat difference: posterior retreat/station general vs extremes—wood 8°33′;

sentences.zh: 火極度，二十二度五十一分；

translations.literal: Mars extreme 22°51′;
translations.idiomatic: Mars extreme 22°51′;

sentences.zh: 土極度，七度五十分。

translations.literal: Saturn extreme 7°50′.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn extreme 7°50′.

sentences.zh: 以上減下，餘以下乘上，水，土三因之，火倍之。

translations.literal: Upper minus lower, remainder lower times upper; water and earth triple, Mars double.
translations.idiomatic: Upper − lower; lower × upper; earth/water ×3, Mars ×2.

sentences.zh: 皆滿百為度，命曰留退差。

translations.literal: All fill 100 for degrees—name station-retreat difference.
translations.idiomatic: ÷100 = station-retreat difference.

sentences.zh: 後退初半之，後留全用。

translations.literal: Posterior retreat use half; posterior station use full.
translations.idiomatic: Posterior retreat: half; posterior station: full.

sentences.zh: 其留退差，在盈益減損加，在縮損減益加其段盈縮泛差，為後退，後留定差。

translations.literal: Station-retreat difference: in excess increase subtracts and decrease adds; in deficiency decrease subtracts and increase adds—for segment general difference as posterior retreat/station fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Gain/loss rules by excess/deficiency for station fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 因為後遲初段定差，各須類會前留定差，觀其盈縮，察其降差也。

translations.literal: Then as posterior slow initial segment fixed difference; each must match prior station fixed difference, observing excess-deficiency and inspecting descent difference.
translations.idiomatic: Posterior slow initial fixed difference matches prior station.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸段定積：各置其星其段中積，以其段盈縮定差盈加縮減之，即其星其段定積及分；

translations.literal: To find five-planet segment fixed accumulation: set each star's segment accumulated center; add or subtract segment excess-deficiency fixed difference—segment fixed accumulation and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Segment fixed accumulation: center ± segment fixed difference;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至大餘及約分加之，滿紀法去之，不盡，命甲子，算外，即得日辰其五星合見，伏，即為推算段定日；

translations.literal: add winter-solstice major remainder and reduced parts; remove era method; assign from jiazi outward—for day and double-hour. Conjunction appearance/hiding is computed segment fixed day;
translations.idiomatic: + winter solstice remainder; assign from jiazi for segment fixed day/time.

sentences.zh: 後求見，伏合定日，即曆注其日。

translations.literal: later seek appearance/hiding conjunction fixed day for calendar annotation.
translations.idiomatic: then appearance/hiding conjunction fixed day for annotation.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸段所在月曰：各置諸段定積，以天正閏日及約分加之，滿朔策及分去之，為月數；

translations.literal: To find each planet's segment month and day: set segment fixed accumulation; add celestial-first intercalary day and reduced parts; remove new-moon policy and parts for month count;
translations.idiomatic: Segment month/day: fixed accumulation + intercalary days; ÷ new-moon policy.

sentences.zh: 不滿，為入月以來日數及分其月數命從天正十一月，算外，即其星其段入其月經朔日數及分。

translations.literal: remainder is days and parts since entering the month; count months from celestial-first month 11 outward—for segment entry month mean-new-moon days and parts.
translations.idiomatic: assign months from eleventh month for segment entry new-moon days.

sentences.zh: 定朔有進退者，亦進退其日，以日辰為定。

translations.literal: If fixed new moon advances or retreats, advance or retreat the day—day and double-hour are fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust day if fixed new moon shifts.

sentences.zh: 若以氣策及約分去定積，命從冬至，算外，即得其段入氣日及分。

translations.literal: If remove by qi policy and reduced parts from fixed accumulation, assign from winter solstice outward—for segment entry qi day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Or assign from winter solstice by qi policy.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸段加時定星：各置其星其段中星，以其段盈縮定差盈加縮減之，即五星諸段定星若以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即其段加時定星所在宿次，五星皆以前留為前退初定星，後留為後順初定星。

translations.literal: To find five-planet segment addition-time fixed star: set segment center star; add or subtract segment fixed difference—for segment fixed star. Or add winter-solstice yellow-path degree and assign—for segment addition-time lodge; all five planets use prior station as posterior retreat initial fixed star, posterior station as posterior direct initial fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Segment fixed star: center ± fixed difference; assign from winter solstice yellow path.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸段初日晨前夜半定星：木，火，土三星，以其星其段盈縮定差與次度下盈縮定差相減，餘為其度損益差；

translations.literal: To find segment first-day dawn-before midnight fixed star: for wood, fire, earth, subtract next-degree fixed difference from segment fixed difference for degree gain-loss difference;
translations.idiomatic: First-day midnight star: degree gain-loss × initial motion rate;

sentences.zh: 以乘其段初行率，一百約之，所得，以加減其段初行率，在盈，益加損減；

translations.literal: multiply by segment initial motion rate, reduce by 100; gain or lose initial rate—in excess increase add decrease subtract;
translations.idiomatic: ± initial rate by excess/deficiency;

sentences.zh: 在縮，益減損加。

translations.literal: in deficiency increase subtract decrease add.
translations.idiomatic: in deficiency reverse.

sentences.zh: 以一百乘之，為初行積分；

translations.literal: Multiply by 100 for initial-motion accumulated parts;
translations.idiomatic: ×100 = initial accumulated parts;

sentences.zh: 又置一百分，亦依其數加減之，以除初行積分，為初日定行分以乘其段初日約分，以一百約之，順減退加其段定星，為其段初日晨前夜半定星；

translations.literal: also set 100 parts and gain or lose likewise; divide initial accumulated parts for first-day fixed motion parts; multiply segment first-day reduced parts, reduce by 100; direct subtract retreat add to segment fixed star—for segment first-day dawn-before midnight fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: compute first-day fixed motion; adjust segment fixed star.

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即得所求金，水二星，直以初行率便為初日定行分。

translations.literal: add winter-solstice yellow-path degree and assign. Venus and Mercury use initial rate directly as first-day fixed motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Assign from winter solstice; Venus/Mercury use initial rate directly.

sentences.zh: 求太陽盈縮度：各置其段定積，如二至限以下為在盈；

translations.literal: To find solar excess-deficiency degree: set segment fixed accumulation; if at or below two-solstice limit it is in excess;
translations.idiomatic: Solar excess-deficiency: ≤ two-solstice limit = excess;

sentences.zh: 以上者去之，餘為在縮又視入盈縮度，如一象以下者為在初；

translations.literal: if above remove; remainder in deficiency. Again if entry excess-deficiency ≤ one quadrant = initial;
translations.idiomatic: above = deficiency; ≤ quadrant = initial;

sentences.zh: 以上者，覆減二至限，餘為在末。

translations.literal: if above invert two-solstice limit for final.
translations.idiomatic: above: invert two-solstice limit for final.

sentences.zh: 置初，末限度及分，如前日度術求之，即得所求。

translations.literal: Set initial/final limit and parts; seek by prior solar-degree procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Use solar-degree procedure for initial/final limits.

sentences.zh: 若用立成者，直以其度下損益分乘度餘，百約之，所得，損益其度下盈縮差，亦得所求。

translations.literal: With ready reckoner, multiply degree remainder by gain-loss parts below, reduce by 100, gain or lose excess-deficiency difference below.
translations.idiomatic: Ready reckoner: gain-loss × remainder ÷100.

sentences.zh: 求諸段日度率：以二段日晨相距為日率，又以二段夜半定星相減，餘為其段度率及分。

translations.literal: To find segment day and degree rates: two segments' dawn separation is day rate; subtract two segments' midnight fixed stars for degree rate and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Day rate = dawn separation; degree rate = midnight star difference.

sentences.zh: 求諸段平行分：各置其段度率及分，以其段日率除之，為其段平行分。

translations.literal: To find segment mean motion parts: set degree rate and parts; divide by day rate for mean motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Mean motion = degree rate ÷ day rate.

sentences.zh: 求諸段泛差：各以其段平行分與後段平行分相減，餘為泛差；

translations.literal: To find segment general difference: subtract posterior mean motion from prior for general difference;
translations.idiomatic: General difference = prior mean − posterior mean;

sentences.zh: 並前段泛差，四因之，退一等，為其段總差五星前留前，後留後一段，皆以六因平行分，退一等，為其段總差，水星為半總差。

translations.literal: add prior general differences, multiply by four, retreat one rank—for segment total difference. Before prior station and after posterior station, multiply mean motion by six, retreat one—for total difference; Mercury uses half total difference.
translations.idiomatic: accumulate ×4 for total difference; station segments ×6; Mercury half.

sentences.zh: 其在退行者，木，火，土以十二乘其段平行分，退一等，為其段總差。

translations.literal: In retrograde, wood/fire/earth multiply mean motion by twelve, retreat one—for total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Retrograde: mean motion ×12 ÷10 = total difference.

sentences.zh: 金星退行者，以其段泛差為總差，後變則反用初，末。

translations.literal: Venus retrograde uses segment general difference as total difference; posterior change reverses initial/final.
translations.idiomatic: Venus retrograde: general difference as total; reverse initial/final.

sentences.zh: 水星退行者，以其段平行分為總差，若在前後順第一段者，乃半次段總差，為其段總差。

translations.literal: Mercury retrograde uses mean motion as total difference; if first direct segment before/after, use half next segment total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury retrograde: mean motion as total; first direct uses half next total.

sentences.zh: 求諸段初末日行分：各半其段總差，加減其段平行分，為其段初，末日行分前變加為初，減為末；

translations.literal: To find segment first and last day motion parts: halve total difference, ± mean motion—for first/last day motion. Prior change: add initial subtract final; posterior change: subtract initial add final.
translations.idiomatic: First/last motion: mean ± half total difference; rules by segment type.

sentences.zh: 後變減為初，加為末。

translations.literal: Posterior change subtract initial add final.
translations.idiomatic: Posterior change: subtract initial, add final.

sentences.zh: 其在退段者，前則減為初，加為末；

translations.literal: In retrograde segment, prior subtract initial add final;
translations.idiomatic: Retrograde prior: subtract initial, add final;

sentences.zh: 後則加為初，減為末若前後段行分多少不倫者，乃平注之；

translations.literal: posterior add initial subtract final. If prior/posterior motion parts unequal, level-annotate;
translations.idiomatic: posterior reverse; level-annotate if unequal.

sentences.zh: 或總差不備大分者，亦平注之：皆類會前後初，末，不可失其衰殺。

translations.literal: or if total difference lacks major parts, also level-annotate—match prior/posterior initial/final without losing decay.
translations.idiomatic: level-annotate total difference if needed.

sentences.zh: 求諸段日差：減其段日率一，以除其段總差，為其段日差後行分少為損，後行分多為益。

translations.literal: To find segment daily difference: subtract one from day rate; divide total difference for daily difference—posterior less = decrease, posterior more = increase.
translations.idiomatic: Daily difference = total difference ÷ (day rate − 1).

sentences.zh: 求每日晨前夜半星行宿次：置其段初日行分，以日差累損益之，為每日行分以每日行分累加減其段初日晨前夜半宿次，命之，即每日星行宿次。

translations.literal: To find each day's dawn-before midnight star lodge: set segment first-day motion; accumulate daily difference for daily motion; add/subtract to first-day lodge—for daily star lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Daily lodge: first-day motion ± daily difference accumulated.

sentences.zh: 徑求其日宿次：置所求日，減一，以乘日差，以加減初日行分，後少，減之；

translations.literal: Directly seek that day's lodge: set sought day minus one, × daily difference, ± first-day motion—if posterior less subtract, if more add—for sought day's motion;
translations.idiomatic: Direct lodge: (day−1) × daily difference ± first-day motion.

sentences.zh: 後多，加之。

translations.literal: if posterior more, add.
translations.idiomatic: if posterior more, add.

sentences.zh: 為所求日行分；

translations.literal: for sought day's motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: sought day's motion parts;

sentences.zh: 乃加初日行分而半之，以所求日數乘之，為徑求積度；

translations.literal: then add first-day motion and halve, × sought days—for direct accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: halve (first + sought motion) × days = direct accumulation;

sentences.zh: 以加減其段初日宿次，命之，即徑求其日星宿次。

translations.literal: add/subtract to segment first-day lodge—for direct lodge that day.
translations.idiomatic: ± segment first-day lodge for direct result.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合定曰：木，火，土三星，以其段初日行分減一百分，餘以除其日太陽盈縮餘為日，不滿，退除為分，命曰距合差日及分。

translations.literal: To find five-planet fixed conjunction fixed day: wood, fire, earth subtract 100 from segment initial motion, remainder divides solar excess-deficiency remainder for days, else parts—name distance-from-conjunction difference day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed conjunction: (initial motion −100) divides solar excess-deficiency.

sentences.zh: 以差日及分減太陽盈縮分，餘為距合差度。

translations.literal: Subtract difference day and parts from solar excess-deficiency parts; remainder is distance-from-conjunction difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: difference day/parts from solar excess-deficiency → difference degree.

sentences.zh: 以差日，差度盈減縮加。

translations.literal: Apply difference day and degree: excess subtract, deficiency add.
translations.idiomatic: excess subtract, deficiency add.

sentences.zh: 金，水二星平合者，以百分減初日行分，餘以除其日太陽盈縮餘為日，不滿，退除為分，命曰距合差日及分。

translations.literal: Venus/Mercury mean conjunction: subtract 100 from initial motion, divide solar excess-deficiency for difference day/parts.
translations.idiomatic: Venus/Mercury mean: (initial −100) divides solar excess-deficiency.

sentences.zh: 以減太陽盈縮分，餘為距合差度。

translations.literal: Subtract from solar excess-deficiency; remainder is distance-from-conjunction difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: subtract for difference degree.

sentences.zh: 以差日，差度盈加縮減。

translations.literal: Apply difference day and degree: excess add, deficiency subtract.
translations.idiomatic: excess add, deficiency subtract.

sentences.zh: 金，水星再合者，以初日行分加一百分，以除其日太陽盈縮分為日，不滿，退除為分，命曰再合差日；

translations.literal: Venus/Mercury second conjunction: add 100 to initial motion, divide solar excess-deficiency for second-conjunction difference day;
translations.idiomatic: Second conjunction: (initial +100) divides solar excess-deficiency.

sentences.zh: 以減太陽盈縮分，餘為再合差度。

translations.literal: subtract from solar excess-deficiency for second-conjunction difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: subtract for second-conjunction difference degree.

sentences.zh: 以差日，差度盈加縮減。

translations.literal: Apply difference day and degree: excess add, deficiency subtract.
translations.idiomatic: excess add, deficiency subtract.

sentences.zh: 差度則反其加減。

translations.literal: For difference degree reverse the addition/subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: difference degree reverses gain/loss.

sentences.zh: 皆以加減定積，為再合定日。

translations.literal: All add/subtract to fixed accumulation for second-conjunction fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: ± fixed accumulation for second-conjunction fixed day.

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至大餘及約分加而命之，即得定合日辰。

translations.literal: Add to celestial-first winter-solstice major remainder and reduced parts and assign—for fixed conjunction day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Assign from winter solstice for fixed conjunction time.

sentences.zh: 求五星定見伏：木，火，土三星，各以其段初日行分減一百分，餘以除其日太陽盈縮分為日，不滿，退除為分，以盈減縮加金，水二星夕見，晨伏者，以一百分減初日行分，餘以除其日太陽盈縮分為日，不滿，退除為分，以盈加縮減。

translations.literal: To find five-planet fixed appearance and hiding: wood, fire, earth subtract 100 from segment initial motion, divide solar excess-deficiency for days and parts; excess subtract deficiency add. Venus/Mercury evening appearance morning hiding: subtract 100 from initial motion, divide; excess add deficiency subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed planetary appearance and hiding: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, subtract 100 from the segment's initial daily motion, divide the day's solar excess-deficiency remainder for days and parts, and apply excess by subtracting and deficiency by adding. For Venus and Mercury in evening appearance and morning hiding, subtract 100 from the initial daily motion, divide likewise, and apply excess by adding and deficiency by subtracting.

sentences.zh: 其在晨見，夕伏者，以一百分加其段初日行分，以除其日太陽盈縮分為日，不滿，退除為分，以盈減縮加。

translations.literal: If morning appearance and evening hiding, add 100 to segment initial motion, divide solar excess-deficiency; excess subtract deficiency add.
translations.idiomatic: Morning appearance/evening hiding: add 100 to initial motion; excess subtract, deficiency add.

sentences.zh: 皆加減其段定積，為見，伏定日。

translations.literal: All add/subtract to segment fixed accumulation for appearance/hiding fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: ± segment fixed accumulation for appearance/hiding day.

sentences.zh: 以加冬至大餘及約分，滿紀法去之，命從甲子，算外，即得五星見，伏定日日辰。

translations.literal: Add to winter-solstice major remainder and reduced parts; remove era method; assign from jiazi—for five-planet appearance/hiding fixed day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Assign from jiazi for appearance/hiding fixed time.

sentences.zh: 琮又論曆曰：「古今之曆，必有術過於前人，而可以為萬世之法者，乃為勝也若一行為《大衍曆》，議及略例，校正曆世，以求曆法強弱，為曆家體要，得中平之數。

translations.literal: Zhou Cong again discussed the calendar, saying: "Calendars ancient and modern must have methods surpassing predecessors and able to serve as law for ten thousand generations—only then are they superior. If Yixing made the Dayan Calendar, discussing summary examples, correcting calendar generations, seeking calendar methods strong and weak, as calendricalists' essential body, obtaining balanced mean numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Cong wrote: "A calendar surpasses predecessors only when its methods can serve all generations. Yixing's Dayan Calendar established the calendrist's essentials and a balanced mean.

sentences.zh: 劉焯悟日行有盈縮之差。

translations.literal: Liu Chuo realized the sun's daily motion has excess-and-deficiency difference.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chuo realized solar motion varies in excess and deficiency.

sentences.zh: 舊曆推日行平行一度，至此方悟日行有盈縮，冬至前後定日八十八日八十九分，夏至前後定日九十三日七十四分，冬至前後日行一度有餘，夏至前後日行不及一度。

translations.literal: Old calendars computed the sun at uniform one degree daily; only then was it understood the sun has excess and deficiency—around winter solstice fixed days 88 days 89 parts, around summer solstice 93 days 74 parts; around winter solstice the sun moves more than one degree daily, around summer solstice less than one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Older calendars used uniform solar motion; Liu Chuo showed winter days ~88.89 parts and summer ~93.74, with solar speed above and below one degree accordingly.

sentences.zh: 李淳風悟定朔之法，並氣朔，閏餘，皆同一術。

translations.literal: Li Chunfeng realized the method of fixed new moon, and qi new moon and intercalary remainder all in one technique.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chunfeng unified fixed new moon, qi, and intercalary remainder in one procedure.

sentences.zh: 舊曆定朔平注一大一小，至此以日行盈縮，月行遲疾加減朔餘，餘為定朔，望加時，以定大小，不過三數。

translations.literal: Old calendars annotated fixed new moons uniformly one long and one short month; here solar excess-deficiency and lunar fast-slow adjust new-moon remainder for fixed new moon; at full-moon addition time fix month length, not exceeding three in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier calendars alternated long and short months mechanically; Li Chunfeng used solar and lunar corrections for fixed syzygies, limiting consecutive long or short months to three.

sentences.zh: 自此後日食在朔，月食在望，更無晦，二之差。

translations.literal: From this onward solar eclipses fall on new moon and lunar on full moon, with no more last-day or second-day discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter solar eclipses align with new moon and lunar with full moon, without shifting to the last or second day.

sentences.zh: 舊曆皆須用章歲，章月之數，使閏餘有差，淳風造《麟德曆》，以氣朔，閏餘同歸一母。

translations.literal: Old calendars all required rule-year and rule-month numbers to make intercalary remainder differ; Chunfeng made the Lindé Calendar with qi, new moon, and intercalary remainder sharing one mother.
translations.idiomatic: Older calendars used separate rule-year and rule-month figures for intercalary remainder; Li Chunfeng's Lindé Calendar unified qi, syzygy, and intercalary remainder under one divisor.

sentences.zh: 張子信悟月行有交道表裏，五星有入氣加減。

translations.literal: Zhang Zixin realized the moon's motion has crossing-path inner and outer aspects, and the five planets have qi-entry gain and loss.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zixin discovered the moon's nodal crossing (inner and outer paths) and qi-entry adjustments for the five planets.

sentences.zh: 北齊學士張子信因葛榮亂，隱居海島三十餘年，專以圓儀揆測天道，始悟月行有交道表裡，在表為外道陽曆，在裏為內道陰曆。

translations.literal: Northern Qi academician Zhang Zixin, because of Ge Rong's rebellion, hid on an island over thirty years, exclusively using the armillary sphere to measure Heaven's Way, and first realized the moon has crossing-path inner and outer aspects—on the outer path is the outer path yang calendar, on the inner path is the inner path yin calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zixin of Northern Qi spent thirty years on an island observing with an armillary sphere during Ge Rong's rebellion, discovering lunar nodes: outer path = yang calendar, inner path = yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 月行在內道，則日有食之，月行在外道則無食。

translations.literal: When the moon travels the inner path, the sun has eclipse; when the moon travels the outer path there is no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eclipses occur when the moon is on the inner path; none when on the outer path.

sentences.zh: 若月外之人北戶向日之地，則反觀有食。

translations.literal: If people beyond the moon in north-door sun-facing lands, viewing in reverse, there is eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Observers in far northern latitudes facing the sun would see an eclipse where others do not.

sentences.zh: 又舊曆五星率無盈縮，至是始悟五星皆有盈縮，加減之數。

translations.literal: Also old calendars' five-planet rates had no excess and deficiency; only then was it realized all five planets have excess and deficiency with gain-and-loss numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier five-planet rates ignored variation; Zhang Zixin showed all five planets have excess-deficiency adjustments.

sentences.zh: 宋何承天始悟測景以定氣序景極長，冬至；

translations.literal: Song He Chengtian first realized measuring shadow to fix qi sequence—shadow extremely long is winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: He Chengtian of Song first used gnomon shadows to order the qi: longest shadow marks winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 景極短，夏至始立八尺之表，連測十餘年，即知舊《景初曆》冬至常遲天三日。

translations.literal: shadow extremely short is summer solstice. He then erected an eight-chi gnomon and measured continuously over ten years, thus knowing the old Jingchu Calendar's winter solstice was regularly three days late relative to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: shortest shadow marks summer solstice. After ten years with an eight-chi gnomon he found the Jingchu Calendar's winter solstice was three days late.

sentences.zh: 乃造《元嘉曆》，冬至加時比舊退減三日。

translations.literal: He then made the Yuanjia Calendar, winter-solstice addition time compared with the old retreated and reduced by three days.
translations.idiomatic: His Yuanjia Calendar moved winter-solstice addition time back three days from the old reckoning.

sentences.zh: 晉姜岌始悟以月食所衝之宿，為日所在之度。

translations.literal: Jin Jiang Ji first realized using the lodge struck by lunar eclipse as the sun's located degree.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Ji of Jin first inferred the sun's lodge from the lodge opposite a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 日所在不知宿度，至此以月食之宿所衝，為日所在宿度。

translations.literal: The sun's location did not know lodge degree; only here using the lodge struck by lunar eclipse as the sun's located lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: Where the sun's lodge was unknown, he took the lodge opposite the eclipsed moon as the sun's position.

sentences.zh: 後漢劉洪作《乾象曆》，始悟月行有遲疾數。

translations.literal: Later Han Liu Hong made the Qianxiang Calendar and first realized the moon's motion has fast-slow numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hong of Later Han, in the Qianxiang Calendar, first modeled lunar fast and slow motion.

sentences.zh: 舊曆，月平行十三度十九分度之七，至是始悟月行有遲疾之差，極遲則日行十二度強，極疾則日行十四度太，其遲疾極差五度有餘。

translations.literal: Old calendars: moon mean motion thirteen degrees and seven nineteenths of a degree daily; only then was it realized the moon has fast-slow difference—at extreme slow it moves twelve and a fraction degrees daily, at extreme fast fourteen and a fraction degrees; the fast-slow extreme difference exceeds five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Older calendars used uniform lunar motion of 13°7/19 per day; Liu Hong showed extremes of about 12°+ slow and 14°+ fast, differing by more than five degrees.

sentences.zh: 宋祖衝之始悟歲差。

translations.literal: Song Zu Chongzhi first realized precession of the equinoxes.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Chongzhi of Liu Song first accounted for precession.

sentences.zh: 《書·堯典》曰：「日短星昴，以正仲冬；

translations.literal: The Book of Documents, Yao Canon, says: "The days are short and the stars are in Mao—thus fix mid-winter;
translations.idiomatic: The Yao Canon says: "When days are short and the stars are in Mao, mid-winter is fixed;

sentences.zh: 宵中星虛，以殷仲秋。」

translations.literal: at midnight the stars are in Xu—thus fix mid-autumn."
translations.idiomatic: at midnight the stars are in Xu, mid-autumn is fixed."

sentences.zh: 至今三千餘年，中星所差三十餘度，則知每歲有漸差之數，造《大明曆》，率四十五年九月而退差一度。

translations.literal: From then to now over three thousand years, the median stars differ by over thirty degrees—thus knowing each year has a gradually shifting number; he made the Daming Calendar, rate forty-five years nine months to retreat precession one degree.
translations.idiomatic: From then until now median stars have shifted more than thirty degrees, proving annual precession; the Daming Calendar used 45 years 9 months per degree of precession.

sentences.zh: 唐徐升作《宣明曆》，悟日食有氣，刻差數。

translations.literal: Tang Xu Sheng made the Xuānmíng Calendar and realized solar eclipses have qi and ke difference numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Sheng of Tang, in the Xuānmíng Calendar, added qi and clepsydra corrections to solar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 舊曆推日食皆平求食分，多不允合，至是推日食，以氣刻差數增損之，測日食分數，稍近天驗。

translations.literal: Old calendars computed solar eclipses all by uniform eclipse parts, mostly not agreeing; here solar eclipses use qi and ke difference numbers to increase or decrease; measured solar eclipse parts slightly approach celestial verification.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier eclipse magnitudes were computed uniformly and poorly matched observation; Xu Sheng's qi and ke adjustments brought eclipse fractions closer to the sky.

sentences.zh: 《明天曆》悟日月會合為朔，所立日法，積年有自然之數，及立法推求晷景，知氣節加時所在。

translations.literal: The Tomorrow Calendar realized sun and moon conjunction makes new moon; the day method established and accumulated years have natural numbers, and establishing law to seek gnomon shadow knows where qi and node addition times fall.
translations.idiomatic: The Tomorrow Calendar treated syzygy as new moon, used natural divisors for the day method, and computed gnomon shadows to fix qi addition times.

sentences.zh: 自《元嘉曆》後所立日法，以四十九分之二十六為強率，以十七分之九為弱率，並強弱之數為日法，朔餘，自後諸曆效之。

translations.literal: From the Yuanjia Calendar onward the day method used twenty-six forty-ninths as strong ratio and nine seventeenths as weak ratio, combining strong and weak numbers as day method and new-moon remainder—later calendars imitated this.
translations.idiomatic: After Yuanjia, calendars used 26/49 and 9/17 to build the day method and syzygy remainder—a pattern later calendars copied.

sentences.zh: 殊不知日月會合為朔，並朔餘虛分為日法，蓋自然之理。

translations.literal: They did not know sun and moon conjunction makes new moon, and combining new-moon remainder void parts as day method is natural principle.
translations.idiomatic: They missed that syzygy defines new moon and that the day method should unite syzygy remainder and void parts by natural principle.

sentences.zh: 其氣節加時，晉，漢以來約而要取，有差半日，今立法推求，得盡其數。

translations.literal: For qi and node addition times, from Jin and Han onward they approximated essentials, erring by half a day; now establishing law to seek obtains the full numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Qi addition times had been approximated since Jin and Han with half-day errors; the new procedures recover the full values.

sentences.zh: 後之造曆者，莫不遵用焉。

translations.literal: Later calendar makers all followed and used this.
translations.idiomatic: Later calendar makers all followed these principles.

sentences.zh: 其疏謬之甚者，即苗守信之《乾元曆》，馬重績之《調元曆》，郭紹之《五紀曆》也。

translations.literal: Those most grossly in error are Miao Shouxin's Qianyuan Calendar, Ma Chongji's Tiaoyuan Calendar, and Guo Shao's Wuji Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Among the worst were Miao Shouxin's Qianyuan, Ma Chongji's Tiaoyuan, and Guo Shao's Wuji calendars.

sentences.zh: 大概無出於此矣。

translations.literal: In general nothing goes beyond this.
translations.idiomatic: In general, nothing goes beyond this framework.

sentences.zh: 然造曆者，皆須會日月之行，以為晦朔之數，驗「春秋」日食，以明強弱。

translations.literal: Yet calendar makers must reconcile sun and moon motion for last-day and new-moon numbers, verify Spring and Autumn solar eclipses to clarify magnitude.
translations.idiomatic: Calendar makers must reconcile solar and lunar motion for syzygy reckoning and test against Spring and Autumn eclipses for magnitude.

sentences.zh: 其於氣序，則取驗於「傳」之南至。

translations.literal: For qi sequence, take verification from the Zuo Commentary's winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: For qi order, verify against the Zuo Commentary's winter-solstice record.

sentences.zh: 其日行盈縮，月行遲疾，五星加減，二曜食差，日宿月離，中星晷景，立數立法，悉本之於前語。

translations.literal: Solar excess and deficiency, lunar fast and slow, five-planet gain and loss, two-luminaries eclipse difference, solar lodge and lunar departure, median star and gnomon shadow—establishing numbers and law all root in the prior statements.
translations.idiomatic: Solar excess-deficiency, lunar fast-slow, planetary adjustments, eclipse differences, lodges, median stars, and gnomon shadows—all derive from the principles above.

sentences.zh: 然後較驗，上自夏仲康五年九月「辰弗集於房」，以至於今，其星辰氣朔，日月交食等，使三千年間若應準繩。

translations.literal: Then compare and verify from Xia Zhongkang year 5 month 9 "the stars did not gather in Fang" down to today—stars, qi, new moon, sun and moon conjunction eclipses, etc., making three thousand years answer like a plumb line.
translations.idiomatic: Then test from the Xia record of stars not gathering in Fang to the present so three millennia of stars, qi, syzygies, and eclipses align like a plumb line.

sentences.zh: 而有前有後，有親有疏者，即為中平之數，乃可施於後世。

translations.literal: What is before and after, close and distant—that is the balanced mean number and can be applied to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: Where results run early or late, close or loose, the balanced mean can serve later generations.

sentences.zh: 其較驗則依一行，孫思恭，取數多而不以少，得為親密。

translations.literal: Comparison and verification follow Yixing and Sun Sigong—take more numbers not fewer, obtaining closeness.
translations.idiomatic: Verification follows Yixing and Sun Sigong: prefer more data points over fewer for a close fit.

sentences.zh: 較日月交食，若一分二刻以下為親，二分四刻以下為近，三分五刻以上為遠。

translations.literal: Comparing sun and moon conjunction eclipses: if one part two ke or below it is close; two parts four ke or below is near; three parts five ke or above is distant.
translations.idiomatic: Eclipse comparison: within 1 part 2 ke = close; within 2 parts 4 ke = near; 3 parts 5 ke or more = distant.

sentences.zh: 以曆注有食而天驗無食，或天驗有食而曆注無食者為失。

translations.literal: If the calendar annotates eclipse but celestial verification has none, or verification has eclipse but calendar annotates none—that is failure.
translations.idiomatic: Failure is when the calendar predicts an eclipse the sky lacks, or the sky shows one the calendar omits.

sentences.zh: 其較星度，則以差天二度以下為親，三度以下為近，四以上為遠；

translations.literal: Comparing star degrees, if differing from Heaven two degrees or below it is close; three degrees or below is near; four or above is distant;
translations.idiomatic: Star comparison: within 2° = close, within 3° = near, 4° or more = distant;

sentences.zh: 其較晷景尺寸，以二分以下為親，三分以下為近，四分以上為遠若較古而得數多，又近於今，兼立法，立數，得其理而通於本者為最也。」

translations.literal: Comparing gnomon shadow size, two fen or below is close, three fen or below is near, four fen or above is distant. If comparing antiquity and obtaining more numbers, and also near the present, together establishing law and numbers, obtaining principle and penetrating the root—that is best."
translations.idiomatic: Shadow comparison: within 2 fen close, 3 fen near, 4 fen or more distant. Best is many ancient matches, nearness to today, and laws that grasp the underlying principle."

sentences.zh: 琮自謂善曆，嘗曰：「世之知曆者甚少，近世獨孫思恭為妙」。

translations.literal: Zhou Cong considered himself skilled in calendars and once said: "Those who know calendars in the world are very few; in recent times only Sun Sigong is subtle."
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Cong claimed calendrical skill and said, "Those who know calendars in the world are very few; in recent times only Sun Sigong is subtle."

sentences.zh: 而思恭又嘗推劉羲叟為知曆焉。

translations.literal: Yet Sigong also once praised Liu Yishou as knowing calendars.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Sigong in turn praised Liu Yishou as a master of calendars.
